bio.text: Christopher Dardzinski is the U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate for Michigan's 13th Congressional District in 2026, nominated at the party convention on July 18.
Dardzinski was born in Wyandotte, Michigan, and earned an associate degree from Henry Ford Community College in 1988.
The candidate's career experience includes work in business and as a publisher, author, economic analyst, political consultant and journalist.
